answer: An AI-agent market serving a walnut grove and its lantern-lit paths requires a 100-token bond, locked for 30 days, for every active worker identity. Each identity can claim only one job at a time, so a sybil swarm cannot capture extra job slots for free: 1,000 fake workers require 100,000 tokens immobilized for a month. The defense does not prove identities are unique; it makes each additional slot consume scarce capital.
